_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd myth_of_empires/egg-myth-of-empires.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) and the start line the game's PrivateServerTool writes (a Steam community post). Octail runs the Windows server under Wine (the image's Xvfb, as the ZAP-Hosting Linux guide does with xvfb-run) instead of Proton, keeps upstream's start options and changes the rest: the join password goes in -PrivateServerPassword, only when set (upstream had none); the address announced to the server list is the Public IP setting, else the allocation's IP, else the address api.ipify.org sees (upstream sent the allocation IP, 0.0.0.0 on many nodes); the anticheat (-UseACE) is a setting (on by default, as upstream and the tool); the shutdown service (an HTTP service for the PrivateServerTool) is off, so no port or key is needed (upstream required a key and port); admins are 17-digit Steam IDs; the map is letters, digits and _; the server's log (MOE/Saved/Logs/MOE.log) is followed on the console, the start is detected from 'Starting Game.' or the bound game port (x_octail.features.ready), Ctrl+C is handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1) and waited for (upstream: no trap); vcrun2022 is installed into the Wine prefix once (WINETRICKS_RUN); the free-form extra flags are dropped; the myth-of-empires and wine tags, an automatic query port (+1), the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, the no_console_input flag (Wine reads no commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints (the game's hosts say 9 to 12 GB), curl with timeouts and retries, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Myth of Empires
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Myth of Empires is a sandbox war game: survive, craft, build and lead troops to conquer territory and build your empire. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: MOE_IP=${PUBLIC_IP}; if [ -z "${MOE_IP}" ]; then MOE_IP=${SERVER_IP}; if [ -z "${MOE_IP}" ] || [ "${MOE_IP}" = "0.0.0.0" ]; then MOE_IP=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 https://api.ipify.org || true); fi; echo "Octail: Public IP is empty, using ${MOE_IP}."; fi; wine ./MOE/Binaries/Win64/MOEServer.exe {{MAP_NAME}} -game -server -DataLocalFile -NotCheckServerSteamAuth -log -LOCALLOGTIMES -PrivateServer -disable_qim -MultiHome=0.0.0.0 -OutAddress=${MOE_IP} -SessionName="{{SERVER_NAME}}" $( [ -z "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ] || printf -- '-PrivateServerPassword=%s' "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ) -GameServerPVPType={{PVP}} -MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -MapDifficultyRate=1 $( [ "${ANTI_CHEAT}" = 1 ] && printf %s -UseACE ) -EnableVACBan=1 -ServerId={{SERVER_ID}} -ClusterId={{CLUSTER_ID}} -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} -bStartShutDownServiceInPrivateServer=false -ServerAdminAccounts="{{ADMIN_IDS}}" & MOE_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${MOE_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${MOE_PID}" INT TERM; tail -c0 -F /home/container/MOE/Saved/Logs/MOE.log --pid=${MOE_PID} 2>/dev/null & wait ${MOE_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## anonymous login: this server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/MOE/Binaries/Win64/MOEServer.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Myth of Empires dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server/MOE/Saved/Logs

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join (letters, digits, - and _). Empty = no password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The most players online at once.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to load: LargeTerrain_Central_Main or LargeTerrain_Central2_Main.

variables.name: Anticheat
variables.description: 1 = the game's anticheat (-UseACE) is on. Turn it off if the server doesn't start under Wine.

variables.name: Server Admins
variables.description: Optional: 17-digit Steam IDs of the admins, separated by ;.

variables.name: Server ID
variables.description: The server's number in its cluster.

variables.name: Cluster ID
variables.description: The cluster the server belongs to.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The server's public IPv4 address, announced to the server list. Empty = the server's own IP when it has one (not 0.0.0.0), else the address api.ipify.org sees.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).

variables.name: Winetricks
variables.description: Installed into the Wine prefix once, at the first start (the server needs the Visual C++ runtime).
